headline: EPS falls sharply both sequentially and year-over-year
summary_short: Triveni Turbine reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₹1.60, down 50.2% q/q from ₹3.21 and down 21.2% y/y from ₹2.03.
summary_long: EPS of ₹1.60 fell 50.2% sequentially from ₹3.21 and 21.2% year-over-year from ₹2.03. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
